payload.idea: MintHunter is an autonomous agent that hunts free NFT mints, safety-checks each contract, and mints only the safe ones — without a human clicking. It finds candidates from curated lists and live on-chain feeds, then runs a 5-check safety gate: (1) Sourcify source verification, (2) free-mint confirmation, (3) deployer exclusion list, (4) EIP-7702 delegation check, (5) drain-pattern scan. The agent identity is a NEAR account; its EVM address is derived via NEAR chain signatures (MPC), and cross-chain execution uses NEAR Intents. The EIP-7702 check is personal: it flagged the phishing delegation that drained my own wallet. Built for the agents track — an agent that spends its own money must verify before it spends.
